install: set -eu; if [ -n "${GCP_SA_KEY_B64:-}" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud"; printf '%s' "$GCP_SA_KEY_B64" | base64 -d > "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json"; chmod 600 "$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json"; export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="$HOME/.config/agy-cloud/agy-ci-key.json"; gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file="$GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS" --project="$GCP_PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; python3 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
